message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I could almost hear the collective groan from my kids. I grabbed my trusty flashlight and called them to the living room, where we set up our little "campout" with power banks charged and a lantern glowing softly. 

As we huddled together, I realized it turned into a fun family moment instead of a bummer. We shared stories and even played a silly game, all while I felt a little proud knowing we were prepared for this kind of thing. 

It’s funny how a little darkness can spark creativity and connection. What are your favorite ways to make the best of a power outage? 🌟
